snippet.title: Cairn - Release Date and Demo | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Cairn's demo is out now! Play it on PlayStation®5 right now:  https://bit.ly/Cairn-PS5Demo
Wishlist Cairn: https://bit.ly/Cairn-PS5Store 

In Cairn's demo you play as Aava attempting your first ascent before heading to mount Kami. After a warm-up in the climbing gym, you climb to the summit of Mount Tenzen. You have full freedom to explore the small mountain ridge, forage, bivouac, and improve your technique in a low-pressure environment.

Cairn features realistic simulation that allows you to climb intuitively, anywhere. Find the best holds and place your hands and feet seamlessly with simple controls. Adapt your posture, effort and balance - if you're not careful, you will fall!
